scopeLimits: Diagnostic boundary/steady discrete-equation checks, not a TMR reproduction or high-Re physical benchmark.
All final pressure-farfield faces are outflow; entering branch implemented and reviewed but not verified by a real entering-flow solution.
Two coarse isotropic meshes have visibly different leading-edge Cf; near-wall resolution and mesh independence not established.
No transient flatplate/checkpoint support, no product GUI entry; desktop remains 0.4.11.
Linux/Windows/OpenFOAM not run; timing single local observations, not performance qualification.
